training_sampling: 1024 evenly spaced nonoverlapping windows across the complete training segment; final incomplete window discarded
objective: ordinary full-vocabulary next-token cross-entropy; no ablation penalty or identity regularization
checkpoint_choice: final fixed epoch only; no seed, checkpoint, corpus or threshold selection using test
qualification: each seed must beat both branch-off and per-head mean by >=1% relative PPL on calibration, with paired-window bootstrap lower delta-NLL bound >0; report independent test confirmation
cache_contract: CUDA FP32 computation, CPU FP32 stored prefixes, no KV cache or dropout; same-schedule full/cached logits and every trainable gradient checked before reuse; frozen weight hash unchanged after each seed
precision: FP32 parameters and activations, no autocast, TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
scope: late-layer GPU TinyEngram/Qwen reference with frozen backbone; not DeepSeek trained weights, convergence or production serving
native_contract: all frozen source rows and original head offsets byte-preserved; include unused rows and metadata costs; staged CPU native lookup replaces GPU-resident source lookup during quality evaluation
runtime_boundary: quality oracle retains dense source and uses frozen-prefix reuse; training elapsed time and allocator peaks are not isolated native serving latency or memory savings
